acceptance_criteria: truncated-tail and corrupt-frame recovery cases; CHK-12, NEG-15, NEG-16.
statement: On recovery, a torn or truncated trailing frame **shall** be discarded (and its bytes excluded from the retained view) while every complete preceding frame is preserved exactly; a complete frame whose digest does not match **shall** stop the scan with `CorruptRecord` without discarding the preceding complete records.
title: T026 requirement 010
verification_intent: truncated-tail and corrupt-frame recovery cases; CHK-12, NEG-15, NEG-16.
